nodes.label: Project Tracker 2.0 release sequence
nodes.description: Stabilization, workspace foundations, configurable operations, reporting platform, field operations, commercialization, Predictive Intelligence and enterprise extensibility.

nodes.label: Forecast evaluation and governance
nodes.rationale: Time-respecting partitions and rolling backtests prevent future leakage; compare naive baselines, record versions and lineage, calibrate uncertainty, monitor drift and fall back to descriptive reporting.

nodes.label: Human-reviewed forecast decisions
nodes.rationale: Warnings recommend investigation; they must not automatically approve spending, reassign staff or cancel work, and predictions must not modify observed history.

nodes.label: Capture once report many times
nodes.rationale: Structured updates should feed dashboards, PDF/Excel reports, presentations, schedules and later forecasts; configuration avoids customer-specific forks.

nodes.label: Graph-first codebase navigation
nodes.rationale: Query the persistent graph before raw codebase searches; use path, explain and section for scoped context and update after code changes.

nodes.label: Projectt Tracker HTML shell
nodes.description: English HTML entry with root mount, /src/main.tsx module, viewport metadata and noindex/nofollow robots directive.

nodes.label: Vite React frontend
nodes.description: Frontend entry points are main.tsx, App.tsx, api.ts and supabase.ts; includes invitation and presentation routes.

nodes.label: Local demo mode
nodes.description: Frontend uses demo mode if Supabase URL and anon key are not configured.

nodes.label: Production database prerequisites
nodes.description: On 16 November 2026 migrations 0024, 0025 and 0026 installed atomic invitations, moved privileged helpers out of public schema and restored invitation RLS policies without changing application rows.

nodes.label: Atomic invitation redemption
nodes.description: accept_project_invitation creates membership, marks invitation Accepted and records audit atomically; only service_role may execute.

nodes.label: Invitation deployment order
nodes.rationale: Apply database migration before backend deployment because the handler calls the new RPC.

nodes.label: Invitation row lock
nodes.rationale: SELECT FOR UPDATE serializes concurrent accepts; later requests see committed status. RPC rechecks status and expiry because token validation is only a preview.

nodes.label: HTTP integration fixtures
nodes.description: Real compiled Express and Supabase SDK use ephemeral loopback Auth/PostgREST fixtures; cover token handling, active profiles, memberships, roles and nested project scope.
nodes.rationale: Fixtures avoid production data but cannot prove hosted cryptographic JWT validation or production RLS.

nodes.label: Binary workbook import verification
nodes.description: SheetJS 0.20.3 binary regression tests and hosted synthetic XLSX upload verify activity, progress, risk and financial records; orange-risk parser bug has regression coverage.

nodes.label: Supabase authentication and persistence
nodes.description: Provides authentication, membership, access control, storage, notifications and invitation workflows.

nodes.label: Vercel Services backend routing
nodes.description: Public /_/backend paths select backend service before frontend catch-all; service rewrite strips prefix so Express receives /health and /api/users/me.

nodes.label: Express TypeScript backend
nodes.description: REST API with project-scoped members, activities, updates, challenges, financial entries, reports, imports and notifications.

nodes.label: Protected deployment verification
nodes.description: Verify health, unauthenticated JSON, deep links, real sign-in, memberships, project loading and runtime logs on exact preview commit; distinguish application 401 from Vercel protection.

nodes.label: Express source entrypoint packaging
nodes.description: app.ts default-exports Express app; server.ts remains local listener; Vercel uses Express source entrypoint, ESM/NodeNext and Node 24 with development dependencies for typecheck.

nodes.label: Credential-free request logs
nodes.rationale: Log only request ID, method, path, status and media type; omit headers, query strings and bodies because Vercel injects credential-bearing headers.

nodes.label: Account loading integration
nodes.rationale: Successful Supabase sign-in does not prove Express reachability; the frontend must retrieve JSON account and memberships from /api/users/me.
nodes.source_location: StackBlitz development: signed in but account does not load

nodes.label: Responsive SaaS grids
nodes.description: 8px spacing system and desktop/tablet/mobile grids with 12/8/4 columns; preserve legibility and avoid unintended overflow.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility target
nodes.description: Contrast, visible focus, keyboard controls, semantic labels, reduced motion and practical touch targets.

nodes.label: Project Tracker UI Rules
nodes.description: Mandatory frontend standard prioritizing usability, accessibility, consistency and visual polish.
nodes.source_location: Project Tracker UI Rules — Premium SaaS Standard

nodes.label: UI HCI pull request checklist
nodes.description: Review shared tokens, responsive layout, keyboard support, feedback, charts and frontend guidelines.

nodes.label: Semantic theme tokens
nodes.description: theme.css is source of truth for navy/teal identity, light and dark modes, semantic colors and consistent visual hierarchy.

nodes.label: Usability and interaction feedback
nodes.rationale: Nielsen, Norman and Shneiderman principles guide visible state, familiar language, context, validation, cancellation and recovery.

nodes.label: Planned isolated Python ML worker
nodes.description: Future asynchronous training, inference, backtesting and drift evaluation with idempotent bounded jobs and disable/rollback switches.
nodes.rationale: Keep heavyweight training separate from user HTTP requests; Python separation is provisional pending workload and cost benchmarking.

nodes.label: Isolated hosted staging
nodes.description: Separate test Supabase project, branch-scoped Vercel Preview configuration and protected deployment test real authentication and cross-project isolation.

nodes.label: CI and production release gates
nodes.rationale: Require typechecks, builds, integration and privacy tests, frontend regressions, security jobs and live staging checks; release only tested commit and verify production application behavior.

nodes.label: Code release rollback
nodes.rationale: Restore known-good Vercel deployment and separately revert offending Git commit; code-only rollback does not restore databases or run migrations.

nodes.label: Forecast tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: Enforce tenant boundaries across feature extraction, training, artifacts, inference, logs and exports; no cross-workspace customer-data training by default.
